description: This file provides interface declarations for window-related bindings in a Lua/C integration, including functions for window creation, controlling the drawing loop, setting frame rate, saving window images, and handling window resize events.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates a GLFW window with specified dimensions and optional rendering mode.

methods.name: noLoop
methods.description: Prevents the lu5 framework from repeatedly calling the 'draw' function, effectively pausing animation.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Allows the lu5 framework to call the 'draw' function repeatedly, resuming animation.

methods.name: frameRate
methods.description: Sets or gets the frame rate for the rendering loop.

methods.name: saveWindow
methods.description: Saves the current window contents as an image file, acting as a screenshot.
